data: the published bin centres and diagonal errors of KODIAQ-SQUAD (Karacayli et al. 2022: the example's 11 bins with the errors of the example's mock, the published final bins, and the full 21-bin layout with its published error columns added in quadrature), eBOSS DR14 (Chabanier et al. 2019), XQ-100 (as read by load_xq100) and DESI DR1
figure: at each bin centre of the same six layouts, the difference between the average over the bin (a top-hat average in k of a cubic spline and of a PCHIP interpolation through the modes, the larger of the two) and the value at the centre, in units of that bin's error: 95th percentile and largest value over the spectra, coloured by redshift
made_by: a check of the project outside this package; its script and the simulated spectra are not in this repository, so this figure cannot be redrawn from it
not_tested: the true spectrum between modes, the simulations' sample variance, the measurements' windows, correlated errors, the emulator
quantities: dimensionless ratios from the PRIYA simulations' spectra and published data errors; no spectrum value
spectra: the PRIYA simulations' own flux power (the total P1D) at their box modes: the low-resolution runs, every snapshot from z 2.2 to 4.6, every mean-flux level; no emulator and no measured spectrum
